Farjius no Jakoutei - Neo Metal Fantasy.name: Farjius no Jakoutei: Neo Metal Fantasy
Farjius no Jakoutei - Neo Metal Fantasy.summary: Neo Metal Fantasy is a traditional Japanese-style RPG released on 1992. Traveling over the world map, the player-controlled party visit towns, descend into dungeons, and engage enemies in first-person perspective, turn-based combat. The game features anime-style cutscenes.

Monster Maker - Yami no Ryuukishi.name: Monster Maker: Yami no Ryuukishi
Monster Maker - Yami no Ryuukishi.summary: Yami no Ryūkishi is a Japanese-style role-playing game based on the setting and themes of the card game Monster Maker and its subsequent table RPG incarnation. The player takes control of a young girl named Raia, who finds out that she belongs to the race of half-elves. Blamed for attacks on her village, she is expelled from her homeland and sets off on a journey to find out the truth about her origins.
